request.description: Records the person's choices against the template version they were shown. The server time, IP, user agent, locale and text hash are stored; `clientRecordedAt` is kept for information only. Every purpose must belong to that template. `missingRequired` lists required items not granted, so the client can block the next step. Records are append-only; publishes `consent.granted` / `consent.withdrawn`. Any signed-in context. Consents belong to the person (their party), not to a role.
